units.known_address_notes: Repo and review confirm identity: dapperlabs/dapper-contracts implements the Dapper Ethereum smart-contract wallet (FullWallet/CoreWallet + WalletFactory that clones per-user wallets, cosigner/recovery keys). README and repo contain no deployed factory address; each user wallet is a clone so there is no single audited instance. Etherscan name search for WalletFactory is Cloudflare-gated and Blockscout Ethereum name search returned no match. -> PARTIAL (repo/anchor found, deployment unpublished).

OtterSec PDF (p.4 Scope) names the audited repo github.com/Doge-Capital/FOMO-GAME @d9c7639 and a single Solana program `fomo-game` (key/ticket game with referral codes). Report contains no program ID and no deployment appendix. Repo returns 404 (private/removed) when checked 2026-11-13; no site or docs found. Solana has no explorer name-search, so the program address is not recoverable. Tried: osec PDF text, GitHub repo+raw, GitHub search, DefiLlama protocol list (no FOMO Solana entry).
